recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-13124 unless future publisher/tooling changes reintroduce a summary-descendant consistency gap; do not duplicate the already-published FHIR-13125 audit.
issue_request: FHIR-13124 reported that Questionnaire.item was not part of the summary while Questionnaire.item.enableWhen was marked summary. The accepted resolution was to remove isSummary from enableWhen and improve tooling so descendant summary flags are not allowed unless ancestors are also summary; modifier summary checks only apply when ancestors are summary.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 11889. In git-svn commit 1ec4a66a17506fa38537e6e2d18b67406ed97362, that revision added a temporary Search _summary STU note warning about parent/child summary definition problems. The resource flag correction appears in same-family commit 0ad99fb844c59d64bf782e85eec2e491813f84c5, which removed Summary=Y from Questionnaire.item.code, Questionnaire.item.text, and Questionnaire.item.enableWhen and added summary consistency validation for required elements under summary parents.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Questionnaire as an active resource. The current Questionnaire StructureDefinition has no isSummary on Questionnaire.item or any Questionnaire.item descendant, including enableWhen. The companion FHIR-13125 audit is already represented on the combined branch and covers the related required-child-under-summary-parent consistency rule. The temporary open-issues Search STU note was later removed by the 2018 summary clarification commit.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current core FHIR source change is needed. The authoritative source already has the requested summary flags, and an active-resource XML scan found no summary descendants whose immediate non-root parent is not summary.
